help.title: Dunn's Test
help.body:
Description
Post-hoc pairwise comparison test used after a significant Kruskal-Wallis result to identify which specific pairs of groups differ, using rank sums with a multiple-comparison p-value adjustment.

Important
Because BioStat Prime's existing Kruskal-Wallis dialog cannot be extended with this post-hoc option, this dialog re-runs Kruskal-Wallis internally using the same inputs before computing Dunn's pairwise comparisons. A one-line Kruskal-Wallis summary is shown above the Dunn's table so you can see whether the omnibus test was significant before interpreting individual pairwise results.

Requirements
• Group factor must have at least 3 levels.

R functions used: stats::kruskal.test(), FSA::dunnTest()
R Packages required: FSA
